title: Demand board and PMO Teams product closure — verification revision 3
decision: Accept revision 3. Keep P0/P1 scope; use valid package test commands and check built Desktop artifacts in the tracker gate because the macOS installer intentionally requires a clean source tree. The clean-tree installer run passed before tracker state evidence was written.
acceptance: P0/P1 product behavior remains unchanged from revision 2.
The gate commands are executable in the current repository and do not encode an impossible clean-tree requirement after the gate writes evidence.
macOS package/install evidence is recorded from a clean commit and artifact presence is checked by the gate.
